title: Emacs Org-mode - a system for note-taking and project planning
summary: A 2008 Google Tech Talk by the creator of Org-mode, introducing the Emacs subsystem for plain-text note-taking and project planning. It covers outlines, TODO states, tags, dates and priorities, and later shows using Org-mode as a spreadsheet.
why: HN regards it as the best introduction and advertisement for Org-mode, and many say it was enough to get them started with it.

quote.text: The best advertisement for org-mode I've seen is this long Google Tech Talk
